description: This file defines a Java interface 'IndelUpdate' that represents updates with insertion and deletion operations, including methods for resetting, snapshotting, exporting, and modifying the element sets.

classes.name: IndelUpdate
classes.description: A thread-unsafe Java interface for managing insertions and deletions of elements, with methods to manipulate and access the update data.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all data within the update, destroying immutability.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable copy of the current update object.

methods.name: exportAndReset
methods.description: Exports an unmodifiable copy of the update and then resets the internal data, suitable for thread-safe asynchronous reads.

methods.name: getInserts
methods.description: Returns the set of inserted elements.

methods.name: getDeletes
methods.description: Returns the set of deleted elements.

methods.name: shouldReplaceAll
methods.description: Indicates whether the distributed data should clear all associations and replace them with inserts.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Adds a new element to the set of inserts.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes an element, adding it to the set of deletes.
